stage.name: Lungmen Commercial District
stage.description:
At the behest of the Rat King, the local Siracusan mafia contacted a number of mercenaries, preparing to bring joy to the city during Sauin. But before they do so, they need to rehearse with Rhodes Island's operators to ensure no civilians are harmed. 
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Mobile Tactical Hangar> Deploys drones as needed to assist enemy combatants. 
<Command Terminal> Depletes 1 Life Points when destroyed.

infantry.name: Infantry
infantry.flavourText: A basic melee soldier. Their armor provides some defense against Arts damage.

sicilian.name: Sicilian
sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

elite_brawler.name: Elite Brawler
elite_brawler.flavourText: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

infantry_leader.name: Infantry Leader
infantry_leader.flavourText: A basic melee soldier. They are stronger than normal Infantry.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.flavourText: Combat personnel who have underwent special training. Their flurry of rapid blows are powerful enough to be fatal.

elite_marksman.name: Elite Marksman
elite_marksman.flavourText: Tactical long-range combatants, more dangerous than a normal Marksman. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Shoots 3 times in a row
Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

tactical_crossbowman.name: Tactical Crossbowman
tactical_crossbowman.flavourText: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses a crossbow in battle and calls for the offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap' to carry out aerial bombardment.
abilities: Before the first attack, calls for <Scrap> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

tactical_crossbowman_leader.name: Tactical Crossbowman Leader
tactical_crossbowman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary using ranged weaponry. Uses a crossbow in battle and calls for the more powerful offensive Air Support Drone 'Scrap Model-U' to carry out aerial bombardment.
abilities: Before the first attack, calls for <Scrap Model-U> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.flavourText: Tactical long-range combatants. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support.
abilities: Shoots 3 times in a row
Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

anti_armor_infantry_leader.name: Anti-Armor Infantry Leader
anti_armor_infantry_leader.flavourText: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. Carries a powerful single-use grenade launcher which is discarded after firing along with other non-essential equipment, after which they charge at high speed towards the enemy.
abilities: Can fire a super long-range grenade, dealing AoE Physical damage
After firing, significantly increases Movement Speed and can only perform melee attacks

anti_armor_infantry.name: Anti-Armor Infantry
anti_armor_infantry.flavourText: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. Carries a single-use grenade launcher which is discarded after firing along with other non-essential equipment, after which they charge at high speed towards the enemy.
abilities: Can fire a super long-range grenade, dealing AoE Physical damage
After firing, significantly increases Movement Speed and can only perform melee attacks

tactical_defender.name: Tactical Defender
tactical_defender.flavourText: A mercenary clad in heavy armor. Has extremely strong defensive capabilities and utilizes the Air Support Drone 'Anvil' to provide defensive support to their allies.
abilities: The first time HP drops below half, calls for <Anvil> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

fanatic.name: Fanatic
fanatic.flavourText: Special long-range combatants. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
bulldozer.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all. Compared to a normal Bully, they boast greater attack power and armor.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

desperate_fanatic.name: Desperate Fanatic
desperate_fanatic.flavourText: Special long-range combatants, with greater combat capabilities than normal Fanatics. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the Command Terminal

tactical_defender_leader.name: Tactical Defender Leader
tactical_defender_leader.flavourText: A mercenary clad in heavy armor. Has even stronger defensive capabilities and utilizes the more powerful Air Support Drone 'Anvil Model-B' to provide defensive support to their allies.
abilities: The first time HP drops below half, calls for <Anvil Model-B> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar

war_phantom.name: War Phantom
war_phantom.flavourText: The 'War Phantoms' were once a legendary band of mercenaries. In the wake of their bloody legacy, mercenaries and bounty hunters began referring to powerful, cruel veteran warriors with the same title. Strong and adept at controlling multiple types of Air Support Drones.
abilities: On first attack, immediately dispatches <Scrap> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar
The first time HP drops below half, immediately dispatches <Anvil> from the Mobile Tactical Hangar to support the battle
When on the field, all Air Support Drones gain greatly increased Movement Speed

bully.name: Bully
bully.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

legendary_war_phantom.name: Legendary War Phantom
legendary_war_phantom.flavourText: The 'War Phantoms' were once a legendary band of mercenaries. Though countless others have appropriated their name, perhaps the legends themselves have yet to fall. Extremely strong and adept at controlling multiple types of Air Support Drones.
abilities: On first attack, immediately dispatches <Scrap Model-U> to support the battle from the Mobile Tactical Hangar
The first time HP drops below half, immediately dispatches <Anvil Model-B> from the Mobile Tactical Hangar to support the battle
When on the field, all Air Support Drones gain greatly increased Movement Speed

rat_king.name: 'Rat King'
rat_king.flavourText: Lin, Lin Gray, the Rat King of the slum. He bears many titles, just like the shifting of the city's shadows underneath his feet. Don't touch the red lines. If you ever have a moment of indecisiveness, whatever it is that you were concerned about will become nothing more than a whisper in the winds above the dunes.
abilities: [Singing Sands] Targets a unit with the highest Max HP, dealing heavy physical damage to the target and nearby allied units within a cross area
[Sand Tomb] Targets a unit with the lowest Max HP, continuously inflicting Arts damage to the target and nearby allies, also reducing their ATK
Appears with a Barrier that can absorb a large amount of Arts damage, gains significantly increased DEF while Barrier is active
Deals more damage when HP drops below half
